channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 18
item.description:
46 development commits

Icon Font & UI Optimizations

  • Auto‑clean dynamic icon fonts on play‑mode exit and added a confirmation popup before scanning updates.
  • Increased icon‑font atlas to 1024×1024 and switched to on‑demand glyph generation, cutting atlas size from 64 MB/4 MB to ~0.5 MB each; added empty fallback dynamic font for community UI icons.
  • Fixed tutorial modal size, removed unused background asset, localized text, and cleaned up the connection‑modal description.

Weapon & Equipment Refresh

  • Updated flashlight entity to reference a new model, rotated the 3‑person view for coherence, added a toggle flag, and reduced AO texture from 1 k to 512 px.
  • Added ambient‑occlusion support to flashlight and renamed conventions to match the new naming scheme.
  • Refreshed machete animation for the weapon refresh.
  • Optimized salvaged hammer textures: AO reduced from 2 k to 512 px, renamed texture set to the new naming convention, and corrected third‑person hand offset.
  • Fixed honey bandage effect trigger.

Navmesh & AI Behavior Fixes

  • Corrected independent navmesh bounds to use monument bounds and ensured AI spawned before navmesh build can locate it.
  • Fixed cargo, underwater‑lab, and military‑base scientists not moving or spawning; also resolved scientists on oilrig crouch‑walking at odd angles.
  • Adjusted old scientists to turn instantly instead of steering, and fixed Scientist2 oilrig crouch‑walk angle.
  • Fixed scientists not spawning in underwater labs and cargo ships.

Vehicle & Asset Pooling Improvements

  • Reset vehicle animators on pool reuse and restored child transforms during pooling.
  • Captured component states during initialization (experimental, needs testing) and added fixes for child pooling on parent destroy.
  • Additional child pooling fixes for OnParentDestroying.

Animal & Livestock Content

  • Added alternate implementation and new model for animal fencing (v2) and fixed missing codegen.
  • Introduced new livestock species assets (cows, sheep) with male/female prefabs; hooked up sheep sleeping animation and prevented movement while sleeping.
  • Extracted full dog asset set from Pets2 branch, including models, materials, animations, entity prefabs, and harness models.

Rendering & Environment Fixes

  • Added radial blur to RRP, optimized combined blur, set up explosion volume and overlay; reduced RRP vignette intensity.
  • Updated laserlight world model and refined LOD components for muzzle brake and boost; fixed rapid LOD switching.
  • Fixed white‑firework pooled strings.
  • Reapplied shadow proxy fixes for RadTown and Oilrig level 6 rooms.
  • Replaced multiple box colliders on Jungle Ziggurat treatment tank with a single mesh collider.
  • Fixed static chairs on gas‑station roof mountability clipping issue.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 17
item.description:
48 development commits

Nexus Server Enhancements

  • Tagged servers with Nexus enabled using nexuszone and exposed Nexus info in A2S rules.
  • Added option to hide Nexus zones from the server list (nexus.hideZones).
  • Fixed map button activation on the connect modal for Nexus paths.
  • Resolved map UI squishing after recent changes.
  • Applied miscellaneous Nexus connect‑modal UI fixes.
  • Corrected MaxPlayers value after Nexus modifications.

UI & Editor Improvements

  • Redesigned Demo UI sandbox panel with parenting, revamped color picker, and key‑framed light intensity/range.
  • Added scroll fade/gradient to Demo UI tabs and fixed left‑offset alignment on non‑keyframable rows.
  • Sorted F1 menu category buttons alphabetically by translated label.
  • Editor multiplayer: final name cleanup, performance‑logging NRE fix, hot‑reload fix, custom scenario dropdown, crosshair NRE fix, and additional second‑client NRE fixes.
  • Updated conditional model handling to respect null slots and refresh only when changed.

Stability & Performance Fixes

  • Implemented threaded‑log handler so messages from other threads appear in console and RCON.
  • Added tests confirming threaded‑log fix and captured exceptions from async tasks.
  • Detached parented children before entering vehicle pool to stop NRE spamming.
  • Prevented rooms from hiding until invisible for 5 seconds, reducing churn.
  • Relocated file‑storage code to avoid unload during domain reload (SQLite clan fix).

Animal & Livestock Updates

  • Added bull prefab setup.
  • Fixed all livestock being set to female and introduced breeding FSM states.

IO & Power System Refactor (Hackweek)

  • Fixed battery ReceiveAdditionalData client RPC and removed legacy IO code from the battery class.
  • Converted CCTV cameras, windmills, water wheel, Tesla coil, SolarPanel, and FuelGenerator; added dummy‑switch power slots.
  • Simplified battery console commands and added related tests.
  • Disabled Unsafe.UseMultithreadedScripting on client and added tests for safe booting in both client and server modes.

Asset & Rendering Fixes

  • Fixed underwater labs window refraction texture with RRP.
  • Added white boomer firework variant (new colour, icon, and PFX) to avoid misleading pack icon.
  • Fixed jungle loot‑box gib material and crate_basic gib colliders; re‑exported crate_basic with zeroed scale.
  • Removed unnecessary prefab and introduced per‑face physics‑material test cube.
  • Reverted previous color‑picker fix and applied an improved solution.
